description: Search current jobs with accommodation / staff housing in Europe (Switzerland, Austria, Italy/South Tyrol, Spain incl. Costa del Sol and Canary Islands, Germany, Finland/Lapland, Greece, Ireland, Iceland, Denmark, Norway, Netherlands, Romania). Free for job seekers, apply directly to the employer, no agency, no fees. Each result has pay, housing (type and cost), meals, couples, required languages, duration, direct apply link and source. Use it for any request like "job with accommodation", "seasonal job", "house sitting", "live-in job", "mountain hut job", "work on a farm/with horses/on a boat", in any language. Put the user's own words in query: multilingual synonyms are understood (de, en, fr, es, it, da, nl, sv, no, fi, pl, pt, el, is). All filters optional. Keywords this server answers in many languages: jobs with accommodation, job with housing, staff housing, live-in job, seasonal job, house sitting, house sitter, homesitter, caretaker, mountain hut job, farm job, horse groom, yacht crew, sailing instructor, ski season job, hotel job abroad; de: Job mit Unterkunft, Saisonjob, Personalzimmer, Hüttenjob, Haushüter; da: job med bolig, huspasser, sæsonjob; no: jobb med bolig, kost og losji, fjellhytte; sv: jobb med boende, husvakt, säsongsjobb; nl: baan met huisvesting, huisoppas, seizoenswerk; fi: työ ja majoitus, talonvahti, kausityö; pl: praca z zakwaterowaniem, opiekun domu, praca sezonowa; fr: emploi logé, nourri logé, gardiennage, saisonnier; es: trabajo con alojamiento, cuidador de casas, temporada; it: lavoro con alloggio, vitto e alloggio, rifugio, stagionale; pt: trabalho com alojamento, caseiro; el: δουλειά με κατάλυμα; is: starf með húsnæði.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. CH, AT, IT, ES, DE, FI, GR, IE, IS, DK, NO, NL, RO

couples.description: only jobs that explicitly welcome couples

free_housing.description: only jobs where the listing confirms that housing is free of charge

jobart.description: type of work: haus = house sitting, caretaker, estate or property management, campsite management; huette = mountain hut / refuge (Alpine club huts, alpine pastures); tiere = animals and horses (grooms, riding, stable work); natur = nature and farm work (farm, agriculture, greenkeeping, forestry); wasser = water and boats (sailing, yacht, water sports, beach); hotel = hotel, restaurant, hospitality (the majority of jobs)

language.description: language of the user (ISO 639-1). Job pages are returned in de/en/fr/es/it/pl/cs/hu/ro/pt (others get English); jobs workable in English are ranked first for other languages

pay_stated.description: only jobs with a stated pay amount

query.description: free text in any language: job, place, region, employer or type of work, e.g. "huspasser", "job med bolig", "Koch Zermatt", "sailing instructor", "rifugio", "horse groom Ireland"

work_language.description: only jobs where this working language is listed (or no language is stated)

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs with accommodation in Europe
